normal.text: Are you here for one video, knowing that's never true?
Are you letting autoplay decide this?
Are you here with time to kill, not a question?

annoyed.text: Again? Are you back after that one video became six?
Are you about to click the thumbnail that always wins?
Are you still meaning to close it after this one?

brutal.text: Are you handing autoplay another hour of your decisions?
Are you turning tonight into a related-videos sidebar?
Are you pressing play on a video you already know won't matter tomorrow?
